LogicalSnapshot.description:
A version token computed by an adapter when no native revision exists.

Provenance: ``captured_by`` computed ``token`` with ``method`` over the
authoritative record as read at ``captured_at``. A well-formed token proves
neither currentness nor authorization; only the authority can confirm that
a token still corresponds to the record and that the caller may read it.

captured_by.description: Identifier of the adapter/authority component and its version, e.g. 'fixture-adapter/0.2.0-dev.foundations'.
captured_by.title: Captured By

method.description: Snapshot method identifier, e.g. 'sha256-canonical-json/v1'. Open set; consumers accept only registered methods.
method.title: Method

token.description: '<scheme>:<value>' token. Method-specific format is checked against a snapshot-method registry.
token.title: Token

LogicalSnapshot.title: LogicalSnapshot

NativeRevision.description:
A revision identifier issued natively by the source system.

``:`` is excluded from the pattern so a prefixed logical snapshot token
(``sha256:...``) cannot be relabeled as a native revision.
NativeRevision.title: NativeRevision

SourceEntityKey.description: Unversioned locator of one authoritative source record.

entity_id.description: Identifier of the record in the source system. Source metadata only; never a portable ID.
entity_id.title: Entity Id

entity_type.description: Source-side logical entity type label declared by the adapter. Not a Drupal schema commitment.
entity_type.title: Entity Type

SourceEntityKey.title: SourceEntityKey

SourceReference.description:
An authoritative record at one honestly labeled version.

Version currentness and access are deliberately NOT fields here: they are
separate, live checks reported by ``SourceCheckResult``.

organization_id.description: Opaque portable organization identifier. Independent of Drupal IDs and never derived from personal information.
organization_id.title: Organization Id

SourceReference.title: SourceReference

SourceSystem.description: Authoritative source. ``fixture`` is the offline test substitute only.
SourceSystem.title: SourceSystem

description:
Derived, disposable projection of one exact source version. Never authoritative.

``access_scope_hint`` is an advisory pre-filter label written by the indexer.
It is NEVER used to authorize admission; only the live authority decides.

access_scope_hint.description: Advisory indexer label. Not authorization; ignored by admission.
access_scope_hint.title: Access Scope Hint

field_path.description: Location of the supporting field inside the source record, e.g. 'answers.screening_python'.
field_path.title: Field Path

index_version.description: Identifier of the adapter/authority component and its version, e.g. 'fixture-adapter/0.2.0-dev.foundations'.
index_version.title: Index Version

organization_id.description: Opaque portable organization identifier. Independent of Drupal IDs and never derived from personal information.
organization_id.title: Organization Id

text_pointer.description: Opaque key into a controlled derived store. Not a URL: no scheme, host or ':'.
text_pointer.title: Text Pointer
